title: Bonsai Automata
game_overview: An idle zen simulation featuring automated power and irrigation grids to grow bonsais to level 100, combined with reaction-based wilderness excursions.
winning_condition: Successfully discover and cultivate the rarest botanical specimen in the wilderness—the Mythic Golden Ginkgo Bonsai—to Level 100 Mastery in your automated sanctuary.
losing_condition: None. The game is a relaxing zen experience with no fail state or game over. When the expedition backpack reaches maximum capacity, the player simply cannot carry additional items and returns to the starting campsite portal to transport all gathered resources back to the sanctuary.

controls.action: Dig action in the radial shovel minigame during excursions.

controls.input: W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys / Virtual Joystick
controls.action: Move the botanist explorer across the excursion overworld.
Select bonsais to prune, purchase machinery upgrades, and manage inventory slots.
Open inventory and equipment backpack screen.
Switch between Greenhouse Sanctuary and Wilderness Excursion view.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Strict 4-Tier Depth Management System: The sanctuary rendering pipeline adheres strictly to four decoupled render passes: Layer 1 (Ground plot base tiles, stone pebble pathways, Torii gate ground walkways, and the complete desaturated placement preview footprint), Layer 2 (Y-sorted physical world entities row-by-row, ensuring specimens on row Y+1 naturally render over Torii gate pillars and flanking bushes from row Y, with all floating telemetry deferred), Layer 3 (Bonsai Level badges and growth progress bars rendered globally across all plots after all world entities have completed rendering, guaranteeing vital growth data is never occluded by foreground trees or structures), and Layer 4 (Player avatar and automatons rendered above Layer 3, with only the elevated Torii gate Kasagi roof archway projecting overhead). 2. Complete Vector Art in Placement Previews: Placement previews render within Layer 1 underneath the roaming avatar, executing the complete vector composition (such as the full suiban tray, sand ripples, moss, and stones for the Zen Rock Formation) in high-contrast desaturated monochrome.
sections.summary: Strict 4-Tier Depth Pipeline, Complete Ground-Layer Placement Previews, and Post-Entity HUD Rendering.
